title: Million Reasons
description: 《Million Reasons》描寫一段充滿傷害、矛盾與掙扎的愛情。歌中的主角一次又一次被對方傷害，內心累積了無數個離開的理由，卻仍然無法輕易放下這段感情。她渴望對方的真心與承諾，但不斷的失望令她逐漸失去信任，甚至開始懷疑這份愛是否值得繼續。面對內心的痛苦，她選擇祈禱，希望找到正確的方向，也期待對方能給她一個留下來的理由。最終，《Million Reasons》傳達的是愛情中的脆弱、希望與不捨：即使有千萬個理由選擇離開，有時只需要一個真誠的理由，就足以讓人願意再次相信愛情。

vocabulary.meaning: 非常多的理由；字面是一百萬個理由
vocabulary.usage: 想強調有很多原因做一件事時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「A million reasons」？
options: I have a million reasons to be happy today.
I a million reasons my holiday next week.
My cousin has a million reasons to stayed home.
Please open the million reasons to let in some air.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：用來誇張地表示有很多開心的理由。
optionExplanations: 正確：用來誇張地表示有很多開心的理由。
a million reasons 是名詞片語，不能單獨作動詞。
to 後用 stay，不能接 stayed。
錯誤：理由不是可以打開通風的窗戶。

vocabulary.meaning: 讓某人離開；感情上也指放手
vocabulary.usage: 當你不再要求某人留下，或允許對方離開時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Let someone go」？
options: I let my colleague go to left early.
He wanted to leave, so I let him go.
My phone let my teacher go to blue.
She lets her brother go yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: let someone go 表示允許某人離開。
optionExplanations: let someone go 後不能接 to left；可說 let my colleague leave early。
let someone go 表示允許某人離開。
錯誤：let someone go 後面需要指人，這句的結構和意思都不通。
yesterday 是過去時間，這裡應用 let。

vocabulary.usage: 想說不再做某件事，或退出一項活動時。
options: I quit to working at the shop.
She quit the school team because she had no time.
We quit to the bus stop at eight.
He quit his plan into the calendar.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：quit the team 是退出隊伍。
optionExplanations: quit 後用 working，不能加 to。
正確：quit the team 是退出隊伍。
錯誤：quit 不是移動到某地；可說 We went to the bus stop.。
quit 表示停止或退出，不能表示把計劃寫進月曆。

vocabulary.meaning: 趕快逃走；避開麻煩（口語）
vocabulary.usage: 遇到很可怕或很麻煩的情況，想誇張地說快逃時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Run for the hills」？
options: I run for the hills to make my bed every day.
She ran for the hills to avoided the meeting.
They wanted me to sing. I wanted to run for the hills.
We run for the hills yesterday before the speech.
vocabulary.explanation: run for the hills 誇張地表示想趕快逃走。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：整理床鋪不等於逃離麻煩；這裡用 make my bed 就好。
to 後須用 avoid，不能用 avoided。
run for the hills 誇張地表示想趕快逃走。
過去事件應用 ran for the hills。

vocabulary.meaning: 彎下身；低頭（表達尊敬或祈禱）
vocabulary.usage: 需要描述彎腰、低頭或祈禱的動作時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Bow down」？
options: They bowed down the bus to arrive early.
I bowed down my report into the printer.
She bowed down the TV to make it louder.
The actor bowed down before the king in the play.
vocabulary.explanation: bow down 表示低頭或彎身致敬；戲中向國王行禮符合用法。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：不能用 bow down 表示讓公車提早到。
bow down 不能直接接 report 表示列印。
錯誤：調大電視音量要用 turn up，不是 bow down。
bow down 表示低頭或彎身致敬；戲中向國王行禮符合用法。

vocabulary.meaning: 指給我方向；告訴我怎麼走或怎麼做
vocabulary.usage: 迷路、需要指路，或需要別人指引時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Show me the way」？
options: Can you show me the way to the train station?
Show me the way to arrived at the hotel.
My cousin showed me the way to the museum tomorrow.
I show me the way very nervous at the interview.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：請別人告訴你去車站的路。
optionExplanations: 正確：請別人告訴你去車站的路。
to 後接地點或原形動詞，不能用 arrived。
showed 是過去式，與 tomorrow 不配合。
show me the way 不能連接 very nervous 描述心情。

vocabulary.meaning: 破舊的；用壞的；也能表示累壞了
vocabulary.usage: 物品用很久、快壞了，或人非常疲倦時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Worn out」？
options: Dad was worn out after dancing all night.
I was worn out to danced all night.
My dad worn out the long journey yesterday.
She is worn out to the office by tram.
vocabulary.explanation: worn out 在此表示筋疲力盡。
optionExplanations: worn out 在此表示筋疲力盡。
to danced 的形式錯誤；原因可用 after dancing all night。
worn out 不能在此單獨作動詞；可說 was worn out after the journey。
worn out 形容疲累，不能表示交通方式。

vocabulary.meaning: 走開；離開（有時指不再繼續爭論或關係）
vocabulary.usage: 不想繼續爭吵，或決定離開某個情況時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Walk away」？
options: I walked away my suitcase at the airport.
She walked away the song on her phone.
He walked away the blue color from the wall.
I was angry, so I walked away and took a break.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：生氣時先離開、休息一下，很自然。
optionExplanations: walk away 不及物，不能直接接 suitcase 表示搬行李。
錯誤：walk away 不是用手機播放歌曲。
錯誤：walk away 不能表示把顏色從牆上移除。
正確：生氣時先離開、休息一下，很自然。

vocabulary.meaning: 困在重複的情況裡；一直重複同樣的事
vocabulary.usage: 描述同一個問題不斷發生、很難改變時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Stuck in a cycle」？
options: I stuck in a cycle my report every day.
I am stuck in a cycle to checking my phone.
I'm stuck in a cycle of late nights and tired mornings.
We stuck in a cycle the teacher's red pen.
vocabulary.explanation: stuck in a cycle 指困在不斷重複的模式中。
optionExplanations: stuck in a cycle 是狀態片語，需要 am 等動詞，不能直接接 report。
cycle of 後可接 checking；to checking 在此不成立。
stuck in a cycle 指困在不斷重複的模式中。
錯誤：句子缺少 be 動詞，也沒有清楚表達重複的情況。

vocabulary.meaning: 保持信心；不要失去希望
vocabulary.usage: 遇到困難但仍想相信事情會變好時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Keep the faith」？
options: I keep the faith to practised every day.
The exam was hard, but I tried to keep the faith.
She keep the faith yesterday before the concert.
Please keep the faith blue before you wash it.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：考試很難，但仍保持信心，符合用法。
optionExplanations: to 後用 practise，不能接 practised。
正確：考試很難，但仍保持信心，符合用法。
過去事件應用 kept the faith。
錯誤：keep the faith 不是『保持藍色』。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: 現在進行式：正在持續的行為
questions.meaning: 描述當下持續發生的行為。
questions.usage: 說明某人現在一直做某事。
questions.prompt: 舞台工作人員正在搬椅子。哪句最符合？
options: The crew are moving chairs now.
The crew moved chairs last week.
The crew will move chairs tomorrow.
optionExplanations: are moving 表示正在搬。
moved 指上週過去。
never move 否認搬運。
will move 指明天未來。
questions.cue: 「You're giving me a million reasons」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: are moving 表示正在搬。

questions.word: 雙受詞：give + 人 + 東西
questions.meaning: 直接說把某物給某人。
questions.usage: 送禮物、提供資料或交給別人物品時。
questions.prompt: 陶藝師把一只杯子交給客人。
options: The artist gives to a cup the visitor.
The artist gives the visitor a cup.
The artist gives a cup the visitor.
The artist gives the visitor to a cup.
optionExplanations: 介系詞與語序錯誤。
人放前，物放後，語序正確。
缺少合理的受詞關係。
to 不應插在物品之前。
questions.cue: 「giving me a million reasons」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: 人放前，物放後，語序正確。

questions.word: 名詞後置不定詞：reason(s) to + V
questions.meaning: 說明某個理由、機會等是為了做甚麼。
questions.usage: 想指出做某事的原因或用途。
questions.prompt: 船長有三個理由要留在港口。
options: The captain has three reasons staying here.
The captain has three reasons to staying here.
The captain has three reasons for stay here.
The captain has three reasons to stay here.
optionExplanations: 此處沒有展現歌中的名詞後置 to 不定詞。
to 後要接原形 stay。
for 後不能直接接原形 stay。
reasons to stay 正是此句型。
questions.cue: 「reasons to let you go」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: reasons to stay 正是此句型。

questions.word: let + 人 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 允許某人做事；不在 let 後加 to。
questions.usage: 准許別人先走、休息或嘗試時。
questions.prompt: 導覽員允許遊客先進展廳。
options: The guide lets the guests entering first.
The guide let the guests to enter first.
The guide let entering the guests first.
The guide lets the guests enter first.
optionExplanations: lets 後不接 entering。
let 後不接 to enter。
缺少正確的受詞與動詞順序。
lets + 人 + enter 正確。
questions.cue: 「let you go」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: lets + 人 + enter 正確。

questions.word: 第二類條件句：if + 過去式，would + 原形
questions.meaning: 假設現在與事實不同的情況及想像結果。
questions.usage: 談不太真實的願望或設想。
questions.prompt: 你沒有私人小船，想像如果有就會去海島。
options: If I had a boat, I would visit the island.
If I had a boat, I will visited the island.
If I have a boat, I visited the island.
If I would have a boat, I visit the island.
optionExplanations: had 與 would visit 搭配正確。
will visited 動詞形式錯誤。
現在式與過去式不對應。
if 子句不應使用 would have 來表此假設。
questions.cue: 「If I had a highway, I would run for the hills」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: had 與 would visit 搭配正確。

questions.word: if + could + 動詞：假設能力
questions.meaning: 假設有能力做到某件事。
questions.usage: 想像某人若能做到某事，情況會如何。
questions.prompt: 想像朋友如果能讀懂地圖，就可以帶隊。
options: If Jo could reads the map, she would lead us.
If Jo could to read the map, she would lead us.
If Jo could read the map, she would lead us.
If Jo could reading the map, she would lead us.
optionExplanations: could 後不可用 reads。
could 後不用 to。
could read 正確，接想像結果。
could 後不用 reading。
questions.cue: 「If you could find a dry way」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: could read 正確，接想像結果。

questions.word: 祈使句：原形動詞開頭
questions.meaning: 提出直接請求或指示。
questions.usage: 在工作或活動中簡單請人做事。
options: Give me the watering can, please.
To give me the watering can.
optionExplanations: 缺少完整祈使句主要動詞。
祈使句用原形 give。
Give 開頭構成禮貌請求。
to give 是不定詞，不是直接指示。
questions.cue: 「Give me a million reasons」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: Give 開頭構成禮貌請求。

questions.word: bow down + to 不定詞：動作目的
questions.meaning: 以 to 不定詞交代動作的目的。
questions.usage: 解釋為甚麼坐下、走近或停下來。
questions.prompt: 攝影師停下來拍下晚霞。
options: The photographer stopped to take a photo.
The photographer stopped taking a photo to start.
The photographer stopped to taking a photo.
The photographer stopped for take a photo.
optionExplanations: stopped to take 表目的。
stopped taking 表停止拍攝，意思不同。
to 後不接 taking。
for 後不能直接接 take。
questions.cue: 「I bow down to pray」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: stopped to take 表目的。

questions.word: try + to 不定詞
questions.meaning: 努力嘗試完成某個動作。
questions.usage: 想做不一定容易成功的事情。
questions.prompt: 修鐘師努力修好一座舊鐘。
options: The worker tries fix the old clock.
The worker tries to fixing the old clock.
The worker tries fixing the clock yesterday.
The worker tries to fix the old clock.
optionExplanations: 缺少不定詞 to。
to 後不可接 fixing。
yesterday 與 tries 時態矛盾，且焦點不同。
tries to fix 用法正確。
questions.cue: 「I try to make the worst seem better」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: tries to fix 用法正確。

questions.word: 使役 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 使某物產生某種感受或反應。
questions.usage: 某件事讓人發笑、微笑或感到安心時。
questions.prompt: 一場木偶秀讓觀眾笑出來。
options: The puppet show made the children to laugh.
The puppet show made laugh the children.
The puppet show made the children laugh.
The puppet show made the children laughing.
optionExplanations: make 後不使用 to laugh。
受詞應在 laugh 前。
made the children laugh 語序正確。
此結構接原形 laugh。
questions.cue: 「make the worst seem better」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: made the children laugh 語序正確。

questions.word: the + 最高級：把最糟情況當作名詞
questions.meaning: 用 the worst 等表示「最糟的事」。
questions.usage: 比較數種結果，指出其中最差的。
questions.prompt: 三個方案中，最後一個最糟。
options: The last plan is the worst of the three.
The last plan is the worse of three.
The last plan is a worst.
The last plan is worst than others.
optionExplanations: the worst of the three 正確。
三者中最高級為 worst，不是 worse。
最高級通常用 the worst。
worst 不是比較級。
questions.cue: 「the worst」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: the worst of the three 正確。

questions.word: seem + 形容詞：看起來如何
questions.meaning: 表達看起來呈現的狀態，未必等於事實。
questions.usage: 描述計畫、天氣或情況給人的印象。
questions.prompt: 天氣預報比昨天看起來好。
options: The weather seems well yesterday tomorrow.
The weather seems to better today.
The weather seems more good today.
optionExplanations: 時間衝突且 well 用法不當。
seem 後形容詞可直接接，不用 to。
seems better 表看似改善。
good 比較級為 better。
questions.cue: 「seem better」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: seems better 表看似改善。

questions.word: worn out + 名詞：過去分詞形容詞
questions.meaning: 形容某物已磨損或用舊。
questions.usage: 描述破舊的衣服、鞋或器材。
questions.prompt: 探險家的靴子因遠足磨壞了。
options: The explorer has boots wore out.
The explorer wore out boots is old.
The explorer boots worn out after hiking.
optionExplanations: wore 不能這樣後置修飾 boots。
worn-out 正確修飾 boots。
wore out 是動詞形式且句子結構錯誤。
缺少 be 等必要結構。
questions.cue: 「worn out leather」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: worn-out 正確修飾 boots。

questions.word: have got + 名詞：口語表示擁有
questions.meaning: 表示擁有，常見於口語。
questions.usage: 說自己有票、工作或想法。
questions.prompt: 園遊會主持人有兩張備用票。
options: The host has got to two tickets.
The host have got two tickets.
The host has got two tickets got.
The host has got two extra tickets.
optionExplanations: has got to 不等於持有兩張票。
第三人稱單數要用 has。
句尾 got 多餘。
has got two extra tickets 正確。
questions.cue: 「I've got a hundred million reasons」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: has got two extra tickets 正確。

questions.word: need + 名詞：需要某個東西
questions.meaning: 直接說明所需要的人或物。
questions.usage: 只需要一件東西即可完成任務。
questions.prompt: 組裝燈籠只差一根細繩。
optionExplanations: need one string 正確。
to 的位置不對。
am need 非正確動詞用法。
need to 應接動詞。
questions.cue: 「I just need one good one」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: need one string 正確。

questions.word: one 作代名詞：避免重複名詞
questions.meaning: one 代替已提過的單數可數名詞。
questions.usage: 在多件同類物品中挑選一件。
questions.prompt: 修理師只需要一顆好電池。
options: I need a good battery one.
The old battery is broken. I only need one good one.
optionExplanations: battery one 造成重複。
good one 可代替前面提到的 battery。
缺少被修飾的名詞或 one。
one 為單數，不能用 ones。
questions.cue: 「one good one to stay」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: good one 可代替前面提到的 battery。

questions.word: stuck + in + 名詞：陷在某種情況
questions.meaning: 表示被困在某處或不斷重複的狀況。
questions.usage: 描述反覆發生的麻煩。
questions.prompt: 社區花園每週都漏水，修了又壞。
options: The garden is stuck a cycle.
The garden is stuck in a cycle of repairs.
The garden stuck in a cycle.
The garden is stuck on to a cycle.
optionExplanations: stuck 後缺少 in。
stuck in a cycle of repairs 正確。
缺少 be 動詞。
on to 用法不合。
questions.cue: 「stuck in a cycle」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: stuck in a cycle of repairs 正確。

questions.word: have/has + 過去分詞：現在完成式
questions.meaning: 過去已發生的事與現在的狀態有關。
questions.usage: 說明某事已完成或停止。
questions.prompt: 修復員剛修好一盞路燈。
options: The worker have fixed the streetlight.
The worker has fix the streetlight.
The worker has fixed the streetlight.
The worker has fixing the streetlight.
optionExplanations: 單數 worker 應接 has。
has 後須過去分詞。
has fixed 正確。
has 後不可直接接 fixing。
questions.cue: 「I've stopped breathing」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: has fixed 正確。

questions.word: stop + V-ing：停止正在做的事
questions.meaning: 停止原本正在進行的動作。
questions.usage: 說明某人已停止一項習慣或活動。
questions.prompt: 鼓手停止敲鼓，聽主持人說話。
options: The drummer stopped playing and listened.
The drummer stopped played and listened.
The drummer stopped play and listened.
The drummer stopped to play and listened.
optionExplanations: stopped playing 表停止演奏。
played 不能這樣接。
stop 後需 -ing。
stopped to play 表停下來為了演奏，語意反向。
questions.cue: 「stopped breathing」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: stopped playing 表停止演奏。

questions.word: if + 現在式：真實可能條件
questions.meaning: 說明未來可能成真的條件。
questions.usage: 設定參加活動的條件。
questions.prompt: 如果明天天晴，就去觀察鳥類。
options: If it will be sunny tomorrow, we go birdwatching.
If it sunny tomorrow, we will go birdwatching.
If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go birdwatching.
If it was sunny tomorrow, we will go birdwatching.
optionExplanations: 一般未來條件句 if 子句不用 will。
缺少 is。
if + is，主句 will go 正確。
was 對應的假設語氣不同。
questions.cue: 「if you say something」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: if + is，主句 will go 正確。

questions.word: that 引導關係子句：修飾名詞
questions.meaning: 用後面的子句補充說明前面的東西。
questions.usage: 指出某個人說過的具體話語。
questions.prompt: 請選出真正有幫助的建議。
optionExplanations: help 是名詞／動詞，這裡需要 helpful 或 helps。
that helps 正確修飾 advice。
缺少 be 動詞。
that 已作主詞，不應再重複 it。
questions.cue: 「something that you might even mean」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: that helps 正確修飾 advice。

questions.word: might + 原形：不確定的可能性
questions.meaning: 表示可能如此，但說話者不確定。
questions.usage: 對天氣或結果作保留的預測。
options: We might saw a shooting star tonight.
We might see a shooting star tonight.
We might to see a shooting star tonight.
We might seeing a shooting star tonight.
optionExplanations: might 後不能接過去式 saw。
might see 表不確定的可能性。
might 後不加 to。
might 後不接 seeing。
questions.cue: 「you might even mean」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: might see 表不確定的可能性。

questions.word: It is + 形容詞 + to 不定詞
questions.meaning: 說某件事容易或困難。
questions.usage: 描述工作或想法的難易程度。
options: It is hard seeing to the trail at night.
It is hard to seeing the trail at night.
It is hard to see the trail at night.
It hard to see the trail at night.
optionExplanations: 原句詞序錯誤。
to 後不能用 seeing。
It is hard to see 正確。
缺少 is。
questions.cue: 「It's hard to even fathom」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: It is hard to see 正確。

questions.word: which + 名詞 + 子句：間接疑問
questions.meaning: 把「哪一些」嵌入另一句，使用陳述語序。
questions.usage: 不知道該選哪條路或哪個方案。
questions.prompt: 旅客不確定該搭哪班火車。
options: I do not know which train I should takes.
I do not know which train I should take.
I do not know which train should I take.
I do not know which train I should to take.
optionExplanations: should 後接原形 take。
which train I should take 語序正確。
間接問句不可用 should I 倒裝。
should 後不接 to。
questions.cue: 「which parts I should believe」｜英語歌詞第 1 頁
questions.explanation: which train I should take 語序正確。

questions.word: 否定疑問句：Can’t you + 動詞？
questions.meaning: 帶期待、催促或請求語氣的否定問句。
questions.usage: 對方明明可幫忙，你想請他伸手協助。
questions.prompt: 你希望同伴幫你抬箱子。
options: Can’t you to help me lift this box?
Can’t you helping me lift this box?
Can’t you helps me lift this box?
Can’t you help me lift this box?
optionExplanations: can 後不用 to。
can 後不用 helping。
can 後不用 helps。
Can’t you help 正確。
questions.cue: 「Can't you give me what I'm needin'」｜英語歌詞第 2 頁
questions.explanation: Can’t you help 正確。

questions.word: what + 子句：名詞性關係子句
questions.meaning: what 子句可表示「我需要的東西」。
questions.usage: 要求別人給自己真正需要的物品。
questions.prompt: 露營者拿到了自己需要的工具。
options: I found what did I need.
optionExplanations: what I needed 是名詞性子句。
缺少 be 動詞或正確時態。
這不是獨立疑問句，不能倒裝。
主詞與動詞語序錯誤。
questions.cue: 「what I'm needin'」｜英語歌詞第 2 頁
questions.explanation: what I needed 是名詞性子句。

questions.word: every + 單數名詞
questions.meaning: 強調每一次或每個個體。
questions.usage: 談每張門票、每個座位等。
questions.prompt: 展覽的每張票都附一張地圖。
options: Every tickets comes with a map.
Every ticket come with a map.
Every the ticket comes with a map.
Every ticket comes with a map.
optionExplanations: every 後應用單數 ticket。
單數 ticket 動詞要 comes。
every 與 the 不可直接並用。
every ticket + comes 正確。
questions.cue: 「Every heartbreak」｜英語歌詞第 2 頁
questions.explanation: every ticket + comes 正確。

questions.word: make + it + 形容詞 + to-infinitive
questions.meaning: 說明某個因素使做某事變容易或困難。
questions.usage: 解釋環境如何影響一項任務。
questions.prompt: 大雨讓騎單車變得困難。
options: The rain makes it hard riding a bike to.
The rain makes it to hard ride a bike.
The rain makes hard it to ride a bike.
The rain makes it hard to ride a bike.
optionExplanations: 沒有使用所需 to 原形結構。
to 的位置錯誤。
it 與 hard 語序顛倒。
makes it hard to ride 正確。
questions.cue: 「makes it hard to keep the faith」｜英語歌詞第 2 頁
questions.explanation: makes it hard to ride 正確。

questions.word: tell + 人 + that 子句
questions.meaning: 把一句完整訊息告訴某人。
questions.usage: 請同事告訴你活動已準備好。
questions.prompt: 請活動負責人確認展區已開放。
options: Tell me that the hall is open.
Tell me that is the hall open.
Tell me that the hall open.
Tell that me the hall is open.
optionExplanations: tell me that + 完整子句正確。
that 後應用陳述語序。
缺少 is。
me 應放 tell 後。
questions.cue: 「Tell me that you'll be the good one」｜英語歌詞第 2 頁
questions.explanation: tell me that + 完整子句正確。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: highway
questions.meaning: 高速公路；（比喻）通往某處的道路
questions.usage: 談城市之間供車輛高速行駛的主要道路；歌詞中帶有逃離的想像。
options: The highway arrived late, so we missed our train.
Our teacher baked a highway for the school fair.
The highway connects our town to the big city.
She packed a highway into her small travel bag.
optionExplanations: 道路不會像列車一樣抵達。
highway 不是可以烘焙的食物。
正確；highway 是連接地區的主要道路。
高速公路無法當作行李放入包包。
questions.explanation: 正確；highway 是連接地區的主要道路。

questions.word: be still
questions.meaning: 保持不動；靜止
questions.usage: 想讓人或物暫時不要動；歌詞的 forever be still 有情感性的誇張意味。
options: Please be still while I take your photo.
The chef was still the cake with a spoon.
The baby was still a new song at the concert.
My bike was still to the cinema every Sunday.
optionExplanations: 正確；拍照時請對方保持不動。
不能用 be still 表示攪拌蛋糕。
still 不能這樣接歌曲當作動詞。
be still 不表示騎車前往某地。
questions.explanation: 正確；拍照時請對方保持不動。

questions.word: cut through
questions.meaning: 穿過；切開；突破阻礙
questions.usage: 可以說穿越樹林、切開材料，或比喻突破混亂與障礙。
options: The bus cut through at a delicious breakfast.
We cut through the park to get home faster.
We cut through our exams before the next Monday.
The dancer cut through the music with a blue scarf.
optionExplanations: 介系詞與意思混亂，不表示行駛路線。
正確；穿過公園抄近路回家。
考試不是可被切穿的物品；應說 finished our exams。
沒有清楚的穿越或切開對象，語意不自然。
questions.explanation: 正確；穿過公園抄近路回家。

questions.word: leather
questions.meaning: 皮革
questions.usage: 談皮製鞋、包包、外套等材料；歌詞的 worn out leather 是帶有特殊意象的描述。
options: This jacket is made of soft brown leather.
Our bus is leather because it leaves at eight.
I leather my new shoes before the family party.
The leather sang every night behind the window.
optionExplanations: 正確；leather 表示外套的皮革材質。
發車時間不能說明皮革材質。
leather 是名詞，不能當「穿鞋」的動詞。
皮革不會唱歌，除非明確是擬人化創作。
questions.explanation: 正確；leather 表示外套的皮革材質。

questions.word: stare
questions.meaning: 盯著看；凝視
questions.usage: 長時間注視某人或某物；對人一直盯著看可能不禮貌。
options: She stared a new coat from the market.
I stare my room clean every Saturday morning.
Please do not stare at people on the train.
The rain stared our picnic into the museum.
optionExplanations: 購買外套要用 bought，不能用 stared。
stare 不是打掃的意思；應說 clean my room。
正確；stare at 是盯著人看。
stare 不表示雨把活動移到室內。
questions.explanation: 正確；stare at 是盯著人看。

questions.word: aware
questions.meaning: 知道的；察覺到的
questions.usage: 知道某個事實或風險；常用 be aware of / be aware that。
options: We were aware the broken bike with a new wheel.
Are you aware of the new school rule?
He put his aware under the chair after class.
The shop aware us a sandwich at lunchtime.
optionExplanations: 這個結構不能表示修車，應用 repaired。
正確；be aware of 表示知道新規定。
aware 是形容詞，不是可放置的物品。
aware 不是提供食物的動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確；be aware of 表示知道新規定。

questions.word: fathom
questions.meaning: 理解、想透（通常指複雜或難以理解的事）
questions.usage: 較正式或文學的動詞，常說 cannot fathom why / how。
options: The singer fathomed louder so everyone heard.
She fathomed a bus ticket to the airport.
We fathomed our books on the desk before class.
I cannot fathom why he left without saying goodbye.
optionExplanations: fathom 不是唱歌或提高音量的動詞。
買車票應說 bought，不用 fathomed。
fathom 不表示把書放上桌子。
正確；表示難以理解他為何不告而別。
questions.explanation: 正確；表示難以理解他為何不告而別。

questions.word: bleed
questions.meaning: 流血；（比喻）承受深刻傷痛
questions.usage: 描述傷口流血；歌詞 bleedin’ 同時可能指情感受傷。
options: The old clock bleeds the time at six every day.
He bleeds his shoes before every football match.
We bled the window open for fresh air.
My finger started to bleed after I cut it.
optionExplanations: 時鐘顯示時間應說 shows the time。
穿鞋要用 puts on，不使用 bleeds。
開窗應用 opened，bleed 沒有此意。
正確；手指被割傷後流血。
questions.explanation: 正確；手指被割傷後流血。

questions.word: heartbreak
questions.meaning: 心碎；深刻的情感傷痛
questions.usage: 常描述失戀或重要關係帶來的悲傷；不可隨意等同一般失望。
options: After the breakup, she needed time to heal from heartbreak.
She cooked three heartbreaks for dinner on Friday.
He put heartbreak into his shoes before the race.
The train announced heartbreak at platform number four.
optionExplanations: 正確；heartbreak 指感情破裂的深刻悲傷。
heartbreak 通常是不可數的情感狀態，不是餐點。
心碎不是可以放進鞋子的實體物品。
月台公告通常是班次資訊，不適合使用 heartbreak。
questions.explanation: 正確；heartbreak 指感情破裂的深刻悲傷。
